evidence: Import content selects a source course, exposes row/section checkboxes plus Select all/none, imports several lessons in one action, then shows them in Curriculum with a completion toast.
Searchable Content Library supports multiple selected cards, Deselect all, a count-aware Add 2 items action, and immediate insertion of both blocks.
Choose design searches existing work, offers Copy to course or Move, and returns the copied item to Activities; only one design can be selected.
Add question configures and commits one original quiz question per modal; no library, multi-select, or batch add is visible.
Quiz builder edits one question and its answers inline, then offers New question; useful authoring counterexample, with no reusable-library batch selection.
